items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: I knew his mother very well, because she used to always come by and see me. She was a nice lady. She played piano. He's doing very good, Graham Young... I just got a call from him.

ctx.x: No, Joe Giuscara(?) was lead. It was Joe, Ray, Graham and myself. He played lead on a lot of things. He was a good trumpet player. And he could play my things
